name: Pandora
fix_description: Contract uses Solidity 0.7.0 without SafeMath. In transferFrom, the allowance subtraction (allowed - amountOrId) can underflow when the caller has insufficient allowance, giving them unlimited approval. Use SafeMath or upgrade to Solidity 0.8+ for built-in overflow/underflow checks.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct reserve-manipulation exploit enabled by an obvious integer underflow/unsafe transferFrom behavior, with only a few contract interactions and no flash loan or complex cross-protocol logic. An experienced auditor could identify the faulty token/accounting pattern and write this PoC quickly.
